references.text: Kishon is mentioned as one of the cities in the territory of the tribe of Issachar when the land was divided.
Daberath is mentioned as a boundary city in the territory of the tribe of Issachar.
Parallel text in 1 Chronicles that also lists the Levitical cities from the tribe of Issachar.
The context for the Levites' cities with pastureland, which were given from the various tribes.
